sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Abhinava Krishna Srivastava Counsel for Opposite Party :- Amarnath Tripathi,G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Chandra Sharma,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned counsel for the opposite party alongwith learned A.G.A. and perused the material on record.

This transfer application has been moved with prayer to transfer the Case No.1890 of 2018 (State vs.
Shiva Mohaley & others) from the court of Judicial Magistrate (First), Varanasi, District Varanasi to District Lucknow.

sentences.text: It is submitted that in this case applicant is wife of opposite party no.2 and daughter-in-law of opposite party no.3.
Opposite party nos.4 & 5 are chachiya sasur and and chachi, likwise opposite Smt Ruchi Mohaley vs State Of U.P. And 6 Others on 13 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/177150279/

entities.text: Ruchi Mohaley vs State Of U.P. And 6 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 party no.6 & 7 are married nanad and nandoi.

Further submitted that on account of demand of dowry and harassment by the opposite parties an F.I.R. was lodged u/s 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. at Police Station Lanka, District Varanasi and now after investigation charge sheet has been filed before the learned court.
Further submitted that the matter was referred to mediation but failed.
It is also submitted that the applicant being wife and lady is to face hardship in attending the court proceedings at Varanasi from Lucknow as she lives at Lucknow with her parents.
Her father is suffering from heart disease and her brother and sister are handicapped and only son is school going child.
In this way, case be transferred from Varanasi to Lucknow in view of her inconvenience during the trial of the case.

Learned counsel for the opposite party as well as learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer as aforesaid and contended that the case in question has been instituted on police report i.e. State case in which applicant is not required to attend the court proceedings on each and every date except on the date of evidence when summoned by the learned trial court.

On the other hand the opposite parties are to attend the court proceedings of the case on each and every date as being accused, therefore, there will be more inconvenience to the opposite parties than that of the applicant.
There is no any other hardship to the applicant for getting the case transferred from Varanasi to Lucknow but it has been moved only for the purpose of making harassment of the opposite parties.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for both the parties as well as learned A.G.A. and on perusal of record, it appears that the case in question is State case in which appearance of the applicant is not required on each and every date whereas the attendance of the opposite parties is necessary on each and every date during the course of proceedings unless exempted by the learned trial court.
The applicant is to attend the court only for the purpose of evidence when summoned in this regard.
There is no any other ground to transfer the case from District Varanasi to District Lucknow..
Accordingly, this transfer application being devoid of merit is, hereby, rejected.

Order Date :- 13.5.2024 Ashok Gupta  Smt Ruchi Mohaley vs State Of U.P. And 6 Others on 13 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/177150279/
